title: The Holy of Holies
gist: The innermost room of the Tabernacle and the Temple, where the ark stood, entered only by the high priest once a year on the Day of Atonement. When Jesus died the Temple veil in front of it was torn in two, and Hebrews says that Christ has entered the true holy place in heaven.

passages.note: The veil separates the holy place from the most holy.
The high priest enters on the Day of Atonement.
